# get_repetitions_to_meet_cutoff { #mofography.compute.get_repetitions_to_meet_cutoff }

```python
compute.get_repetitions_to_meet_cutoff(ase_atoms, cutoff=12.5)
```

It takes an ASE atoms object and a cutoff distance, and returns the number of unit cells in each
direction that are needed to ensure that the cutoff distance is satisfied

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                       | Default    |
|-----------|--------|---------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms |        | ASE atoms object                                  | _required_ |
| cutoff    |        | the cutoff distance for the pairwise interactions | `12.5`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                     |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The number of repetitions in each direction to meet the cutoff. |
